question: Is the Nine Sword Style: Ashura Bakkei: Moja no Tawamure technique used by Zoro in Chapter 1010 named after the rakugo story "Jigoku Bakkei: Moja no Tawamure"?
answer: That's right! It's a well-known rakugo story. I know, I know, none of you listen to rakugo! But isn't the title cool!? The performance was the specialty of Master Beicho Katsura and the story is like a sightseeing tour through hell, it's enthralling.
name: Khema
